items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: San Francisco for a three-week stand at the Jazz Workshop with Curtis Fuller, Leroy Vinegar, and Lenny McBrown

ctx.x: And then one other detail before you get to Trane. It says you also worked locally with Benny Golson, which you’ve already corroborated. It goes on to say Benny Golson took you to

San Francisco for a three-week stand at the Jazz Workshop with Curtis Fuller, Leroy Vinegar, and Lenny McBrown and this turned into your first important engagement because in 1959, this lead to the Jazztet.
